Anthropic Releases Claude Science for Automating Research. Philip Morris Can Market Zyn as Lower Risk Than Cigarettes   The Food and Drug Administration authorized Philip Morris International Inc. to market its Zyn nicotine pouches as less harmful than cigarettes, the first time the category has received the distinction. Philip Morris Can Market Zyn as Lower Risk Than Cigarettes.
